title: Fivetran Connector Sync Failures
dataSources: Fivetran log-service events and REST API (`connectors`, sync status), Airbyte job logs (`airbyte:job`), Matillion task history, Kafka Connect connector/task status, AWS Glue job runs (CloudWatch), ADF pipeline runs (Azure Monitor).
app: Fivetran / Airbyte / Stitch / Matillion logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; Kafka Connect JMX/REST; cloud ELT via `Splunk_TA_aws` (Glue) and `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (ADF).
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=fivetran:log event=sync_end
| stats count as syncs, sum(eval(status="FAILURE")) as failures by connector_name, schema_name
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/syncs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Fivetran connector sync outcomes and ranks connectors by failure rate, exposing the ingestion sources that have stopped delivering data.
value: A failed Fivetran sync means a source stops flowing into the warehouse and every downstream model goes stale; failure rate points at the worst connectors.
implementation: Send the Fivetran log service to HEC (or poll the REST API); schedule hourly; alert on failures for critical connectors.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of sync failures, alert.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the connectors that copy data from your apps into the warehouse and flag when one stops working.
